metrics.name: vllm:num_requests_running
metrics.documentation: Number of requests in model execution batches.

metrics.name: vllm:num_requests_waiting
metrics.documentation: Number of requests waiting to be processed.

metrics.name: vllm:num_requests_waiting_by_reason
metrics.documentation: Number of waiting requests by reason. Reason labels: 'capacity' = waiting for scheduling capacity; 'deferred' = deferred by transient constraints (LoRA budget, KV transfer, blocked status). Sum of all reasons equals vllm:num_requests_waiting.

metrics.name: vllm:num_requests_kv_fetch_by_stage
metrics.documentation: Number of waiting requests by async KV load stage. Stage labels: 'waiting_to_start' = needs an async KV load that has not started; 'in_progress' = load started and not yet reported finished; 'completed_waiting' = load finished, request not running yet.
conditions: kv_transfer_config is not None and kv_transfer_config.is_kv_consumer

metrics.name: vllm:engine_sleep_state
metrics.documentation: Engine sleep state; awake = 0 means engine is sleeping; awake = 1 means engine is awake; weights_offloaded = 1 means sleep level 1; discard_all = 1 means sleep level 2.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc
metrics.documentation: KV-cache usage. 1 means 100 percent usage.

metrics.name: vllm:corrupted_requests
metrics.documentation: Corrupted requests, in terms of total number of requests with NaNs in logits.

metrics.name: vllm:watermark_requests
metrics.documentation: Finished requests by watermark status (only with watermark_config).

metrics.name: vllm:prefix_cache_queries
metrics.documentation: Prefix cache queries, in terms of number of queried tokens.

metrics.name: vllm:prefix_cache_hits
metrics.documentation: Prefix cache hits, in terms of number of cached tokens.

metrics.name: vllm:external_prefix_cache_queries
metrics.documentation: External prefix cache queries from KV connector cross-instance cache sharing, in terms of number of queried tokens.

metrics.name: vllm:external_prefix_cache_hits
metrics.documentation: External prefix cache hits from KV connector cross-instance cache sharing, in terms of number of cached tokens.

metrics.name: vllm:mm_cache_queries
metrics.documentation: Multi-modal cache queries, in terms of number of queried items.

metrics.name: vllm:mm_cache_hits
metrics.documentation: Multi-modal cache hits, in terms of number of cached items.

metrics.name: vllm:num_preemptions
metrics.documentation: Cumulative number of preemption from the engine.

metrics.name: vllm:prompt_tokens
metrics.documentation: Number of prefill tokens processed.

metrics.name: vllm:prompt_tokens_by_source
metrics.documentation: Number of prompt tokens by source.

metrics.name: vllm:prompt_tokens_cached
metrics.documentation: Number of cached prompt tokens (local + external).

metrics.name: vllm:prompt_tokens_cached_by_source
metrics.documentation: Prefix-cache hit tokens by the cache tier that supplied them: device (local HBM), host (offloaded to DRAM), disk, p2p (transferred from another vLLM instance) or external_unspecified. Counted at admission; sums to vllm:prefix_cache_hits + vllm:external_prefix_cache_hits.

metrics.name: vllm:generation_tokens
metrics.documentation: Number of generation tokens processed.

metrics.name: vllm:request_success
metrics.documentation: Count of successfully processed requests.

metrics.name: vllm:admission_rejections
metrics.documentation: Number of admission attempts rejected by a queue limit, by reason.

metrics.name: vllm:request_prompt_tokens
metrics.documentation: Number of prefill tokens processed.
metrics.buckets_note: family "request_tokens": 1-2-5 series up to max_model_len (build_1_2_5_buckets); --custom-histogram-buckets can replace it

metrics.name: vllm:request_generation_tokens
metrics.documentation: Number of generation tokens processed.
metrics.buckets_note: family "request_tokens": 1-2-5 series up to max_model_len (build_1_2_5_buckets); --custom-histogram-buckets can replace it

metrics.name: vllm:iteration_tokens_total
metrics.documentation: Histogram of number of tokens per engine_step.

metrics.name: vllm:request_max_num_generation_tokens
metrics.documentation: Histogram of maximum number of requested generation tokens.
metrics.buckets_note: family "request_tokens": 1-2-5 series up to max_model_len (build_1_2_5_buckets); --custom-histogram-buckets can replace it

metrics.name: vllm:request_params_n
metrics.documentation: Histogram of the n request parameter.

metrics.name: vllm:request_params_max_tokens
metrics.documentation: Histogram of the max_tokens request parameter.
metrics.buckets_note: family "request_tokens": 1-2-5 series up to max_model_len (build_1_2_5_buckets); --custom-histogram-buckets can replace it

metrics.name: vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds
metrics.documentation: Histogram of time to first token in seconds.

metrics.name: vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds
metrics.documentation: Histogram of inter-token latency in seconds.

metrics.name: vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds
metrics.documentation: Histogram of time_per_output_token_seconds per request.

metrics.name: vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds
metrics.documentation: Histogram of e2e request latency in seconds.

metrics.name: vllm:request_queue_time_seconds
metrics.documentation: Histogram of time spent in WAITING phase for request.

metrics.name: vllm:request_inference_time_seconds
metrics.documentation: Histogram of time spent in RUNNING phase for request.

metrics.name: vllm:request_prefill_time_seconds
metrics.documentation: Histogram of time spent in PREFILL phase for request.

metrics.name: vllm:request_decode_time_seconds
metrics.documentation: Histogram of time spent in DECODE phase for request.

metrics.name: vllm:request_num_preemptions
metrics.documentation: Histogram of the number of times a request was preempted.

metrics.name: vllm:request_prefill_kv_computed_tokens
metrics.documentation: Histogram of new KV tokens computed during prefill (excluding cached tokens).
metrics.buckets_note: family "request_tokens": 1-2-5 series up to max_model_len (build_1_2_5_buckets); --custom-histogram-buckets can replace it

metrics.name: vllm:kv_block_lifetime_seconds
metrics.documentation: Histogram of KV cache block lifetime from allocation to eviction. Sampled metrics (controlled by --kv-cache-metrics-sample).

metrics.name: vllm:kv_block_idle_before_evict_seconds
metrics.documentation: Histogram of idle time before KV cache block eviction. Sampled metrics (controlled by --kv-cache-metrics-sample).

metrics.name: vllm:kv_block_reuse_gap_seconds
metrics.documentation: Histogram of time gaps between consecutive KV cache block accesses. Only the most recent accesses are recorded (ring buffer). Sampled metrics (controlled by --kv-cache-metrics-sample).

metrics.name: vllm:lora_requests_info
metrics.documentation: Running stats on lora requests.

metrics.name: vllm:cache_config_info
metrics.documentation: Information of the LLMEngine CacheConfig

metrics.name: vllm:estimated_flops_per_gpu_total
metrics.documentation: Estimated number of floating point operations per GPU (for Model Flops Utilization calculations).

metrics.name: vllm:estimated_read_bytes_per_gpu_total
metrics.documentation: Estimated number of bytes read from memory per GPU (for Model Flops Utilization calculations).

metrics.name: vllm:estimated_write_bytes_per_gpu_total
metrics.documentation: Estimated number of bytes written to memory per GPU (for Model Flops Utilization calculations).

metrics.name: vllm:diffusion_num_denoising_steps
metrics.documentation: Number of denoising steps.

metrics.name: vllm:diffusion_num_canvas_positions
metrics.documentation: Number of canvas positions evaluated.

metrics.name: vllm:diffusion_num_committed_tokens
metrics.documentation: Number of committed (finalized) tokens.

metrics.name: vllm:spec_decode_num_drafts
metrics.documentation: Number of spec decoding drafts.

metrics.name: vllm:spec_decode_num_draft_tokens
metrics.documentation: Number of draft tokens.

metrics.name: vllm:spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens
metrics.documentation: Number of accepted tokens.

metrics.name: vllm:spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens_per_pos
metrics.documentation: Accepted tokens per draft position.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_config_info
metrics.documentation: Static configuration of the KV offload managers of this engine instance. The configured offloading spec declares the label names, and each manager fills the values, so a series appears from the first scheduler step of its engine. A manager reports one series for each configuration it holds, and a …

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_load_bytes
metrics.documentation: Total bytes loaded from offload storage to GPU.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_load_time
metrics.documentation: Total load time from offload storage to GPU, in seconds.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_load_size
metrics.documentation: Histogram of KV offload load operation size, in bytes.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_store_bytes
metrics.documentation: Total bytes stored from GPU to offload storage.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_store_time
metrics.documentation: Total store time from GPU to offload storage, in seconds.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_store_size
metrics.documentation: Histogram of KV offload store operation size, in bytes.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_lookup_sync_delay_seconds
metrics.documentation: Histogram of the time spent in a single offload lookup call, in seconds.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_lookup_async_delay_seconds
metrics.documentation: Histogram of time between a request's offload lookup first deferring and the following lookup resolving, or request finish, in seconds.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_allocation_failure
metrics.documentation: Number of KV offload store allocation attempts that failed.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_total_bytes
metrics.documentation: Number of bytes offloaded by KV connector

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_total_time
metrics.documentation: Total time measured by all KV offloading operations

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_size
metrics.documentation: Histogram of KV offload transfer size, in bytes.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_cpu_cache_usage_perc
metrics.documentation: Fraction of CPU KV-cache space currently pinned by active transfers (0.0 = idle, 1.0 = saturated). Sustained high values indicate transfers (stores or promotions) may be dropped due to insufficient capacity.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_cpu_cache_write_usage_perc
metrics.documentation: Fraction of CPU KV-cache space currently pinned by in-flight stores that have not yet completed (0.0 = idle, 1.0 = saturated).

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_cpu_cache_read_usage_perc
metrics.documentation: Fraction of CPU KV-cache space currently pinned by in-flight loads that have not yet completed (0.0 = idle, 1.0 = saturated).

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_cpu_allocation_size
metrics.documentation: Histogram of the number of CPU chunks requested by each KV offload prepare_store call.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_stores_skipped
metrics.documentation: Number of KV offload stores skipped because the reuse threshold was not reached.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_tiering_lookup_sync_delay_seconds
metrics.documentation: Histogram of blocking time spent in a per-chunk tier lookup that resolved as a hit or miss, labeled by tier, in seconds.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_tiering_lookup_async_delay_seconds
metrics.documentation: Histogram of wall-clock time from a per-chunk tier lookup first returning retry until that same tier lookup resolves as a hit or miss, labeled by tier, in seconds.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_tiering_read_bytes
metrics.documentation: Total bytes read from secondary tiers into the primary tier, labeled by tier.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_tiering_read_time
metrics.documentation: Total time spent reading from secondary tiers into the primary tier, in seconds, labeled by tier. Tiers that do not report per-job transfer time have no series here. Use vllm:kv_offload_tiering_promotion_latency_seconds for tier-independent promotion timing.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_tiering_write_bytes
metrics.documentation: Total bytes written from the primary tier to secondary tiers, labeled by tier.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_tiering_write_time
metrics.documentation: Total time spent writing from the primary tier to secondary tiers, in seconds, labeled by tier. Tiers that do not report per-job transfer time have no series here.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_tiering_promotion_job_failures
metrics.documentation: Number of failed secondary-tier promotion jobs, labeled by tier.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_tiering_cascade_job_failures
metrics.documentation: Number of failed secondary-tier cascade jobs, labeled by tier.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_tiering_chunk_queries
metrics.documentation: Number of chunk lookup queries sent to a tier, labeled by tier.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_tiering_chunk_hits
metrics.documentation: Number of chunk lookup hits in a tier, labeled by tier.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_tiering_promotion_allocation_failures
metrics.documentation: Number of promotion attempts that failed because the primary tier could not allocate space.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_tiering_primary_write_usage_perc
metrics.documentation: Current fraction of primary-tier space used by writes from secondary tiers, labeled by tier.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_tiering_primary_read_usage_perc
metrics.documentation: Current fraction of primary-tier space used by reads to secondary tiers, labeled by tier.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_tiering_active_promotion_jobs
metrics.documentation: Number of active secondary-tier promotion jobs, labeled by tier.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_tiering_active_cascade_jobs
metrics.documentation: Number of active secondary-tier cascade jobs, labeled by tier.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_tiering_promotion_latency_seconds
metrics.documentation: Histogram of per-job latency for secondary-tier promotion attempts, measured from job creation until the tiering manager observes completion so that tier queueing is included, labeled by tier and result, in seconds. Includes failed attempts.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_tiering_backpressure_store_latency_ema
metrics.documentation: Exponential moving average of store latency for back-pressure detection, in s/MiB.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_tiering_backpressure_stores_dropped
metrics.documentation: Number of store operations dropped due to back-pressure on a secondary tier.

metrics.name: vllm:kv_offload_tiering_backpressure_blocks_dropped
metrics.documentation: Number of blocks dropped due to back-pressure on a secondary tier.

metrics.name: vllm:simple_kv_offload_save_outcomes_total
metrics.documentation: Store admission decisions in SimpleCPUOffloadConnector, by outcome. Outcomes classify eager-mode boundary hand-off stores; lazy-mode stores are not classified.

metrics.name: vllm:simple_kv_offload_load_blocks_total
metrics.documentation: KV blocks restored to GPU from the offload pool, counted when a load finishes. This is prefill work avoided through offload cache hits.

metrics.name: vllm:simple_kv_offload_used_blocks
metrics.documentation: Offload-pool blocks currently pinned by in-flight transfers or cache hits (capacity minus free). Evictable cached blocks are not counted; capacity_blocks is on vllm:simple_kv_offload_info.

metrics.name: vllm:simple_kv_offload_pending_store_blocks
metrics.documentation: Offload blocks in pending stores: queued for dispatch, issued to workers, or awaiting release after a cache reset. A persistently growing value indicates a stuck transfer.

metrics.name: vllm:simple_kv_offload_info
metrics.documentation: SimpleCPUOffloadConnector deployment facts. Value is always 1. backend is cpu or disk; page_cache and lazy_offload are true/false; capacity_blocks is the offload pool size.

metrics.name: vllm:nixl_xfer_time_seconds
metrics.documentation: Histogram of transfer duration for NIXL KV Cache transfers.

metrics.name: vllm:nixl_post_time_seconds
metrics.documentation: Histogram of transfer post time for NIXL KV Cache transfers.

metrics.name: vllm:nixl_bytes_transferred
metrics.documentation: Histogram of bytes transferred per NIXL KV Cache transfers.
metrics.buckets_note: computed: [2 ** (10 + i) for i in range(1, 25, 2)]

metrics.name: vllm:nixl_num_descriptors
metrics.documentation: Histogram of number of descriptors per NIXL KV Cache transfers.

metrics.name: vllm:nixl_num_failed_transfers
metrics.documentation: Number of failed NIXL KV Cache transfers, including handshake and notification failures. NOTE: KV expiry is tracked separately in vllm:nixl_num_kv_expired_reqs.

metrics.name: vllm:nixl_num_failed_notifications
metrics.documentation: Number of failed NIXL KV Cache notifications. Retained for compatibility; these failures are also included in vllm:nixl_num_failed_transfers.

metrics.name: vllm:nixl_num_kv_expired_reqs
metrics.documentation: Number of requests that had their KV expire. NOTE: This metric is tracked on the P instance.

metrics.name: vllm:nixl_num_notifications_after_expiry
metrics.documentation: Number of completion notifications for requests that were no longer tracked, usually because their KV lease expired. The KV blocks may have been reused before the transfer finished. Counted per notification (one per remote rank), not per request.

metrics.name: vllm:mooncake_store_operation_time_seconds
metrics.documentation: Histogram of Mooncake store communication time.

metrics.name: vllm:mooncake_store_operation_total
metrics.documentation: Number of Mooncake store communication operations.

metrics.name: vllm:mooncake_store_operation_keys_total
metrics.documentation: Number of Mooncake store keys touched by operations.

metrics.name: vllm:mooncake_store_operation_bytes_total
metrics.documentation: Number of bytes transferred by Mooncake store operations.

metrics.name: vllm:mooncake_store_operation_failed_keys_total
metrics.documentation: Number of Mooncake store keys that failed in operations.

metrics.name: vllm:hf3fs_save_duration_seconds
metrics.documentation: Histogram of save duration for HF3FSKVConnector.

metrics.name: vllm:hf3fs_load_duration_seconds
metrics.documentation: Histogram of load duration for HF3FSKVConnector.

metrics.name: vllm:hf3fs_num_failed_save
metrics.documentation: Number of failed HF3FS KV save.

metrics.name: vllm:hf3fs_num_failed_load
metrics.documentation: Number of failed HF3FS KV load.

metrics.name: vllm:hisparse_cache_hits
metrics.documentation: Number of HiSparse device hot-buffer hits.

metrics.name: vllm:hisparse_cache_misses
metrics.documentation: Number of HiSparse device hot-buffer misses.

metrics.name: vllm:hisparse_host_to_device_bytes
metrics.documentation: Bytes transferred from host KV storage to HiSparse hot buffers.

metrics.name: vllm:hisparse_host_cache_usage_perc
metrics.documentation: HiSparse host KV-cache usage. 1 means 100 percent usage. Evictable cached blocks count as free.

metrics.name: vllm:hisparse_pending_page_transfers
metrics.documentation: HiSparse page transfers (write-backs and restores) not yet completed.

metrics.name: vllm:hisparse_host_block_lifetime_seconds
metrics.documentation: Histogram of HiSparse host KV block lifetime from allocation to eviction. Sampled metrics (controlled by --kv-cache-metrics-sample).

metrics.name: vllm:hisparse_host_block_idle_before_evict_seconds
metrics.documentation: Histogram of HiSparse host KV block idle time before eviction. Sampled metrics (controlled by --kv-cache-metrics-sample).

metrics.name: vllm:hisparse_host_block_reuse_gap_seconds
metrics.documentation: Histogram of time gaps between consecutive HiSparse host KV block accesses. Sampled metrics (controlled by --kv-cache-metrics-sample).

metrics.name: vllm:rl_weight_update_operation_duration_seconds
metrics.documentation: Duration of one weight-transfer operation.

metrics.name: vllm:rl_weight_update_operations_in_flight
metrics.documentation: Weight-transfer operations currently awaited.

metrics.name: vllm:sleep_mode_operation_duration_seconds
metrics.documentation: Duration of one sleep-mode operation.

metrics.name: vllm:sleep_mode_operations_in_flight
metrics.documentation: Sleep-mode operations currently awaited.

metrics.name: vllm:websocket_connections_active
metrics.documentation: Number of currently active WebSocket connections.

metrics.name: vllm:websocket_connections_total
metrics.documentation: Total number of WebSocket connections.

metrics.name: vllm:websocket_connection_duration_seconds
metrics.documentation: Duration of WebSocket connections in seconds.

metrics.name: vllm:tool_call_parser_invocations_total
metrics.documentation: Total number of ToolParser invocations. Non-streaming increments once per choice; streaming increments once per delta.
